# Repository Bug Hunt: clash-for-linux-install

> **Date:** 2026-03-26  
> **Scope:** All shell scripts (`script/`, `vpn-tools/`, `install.sh`, `uninstall.sh`), Python audit scripts (`script/*.py`), systemd units  
> **Method:** Automated `bash -n` + manual deep-read by category (variable handling, error handling, logic, security, resource management)

## Executive Summary

- Findings: **7 🔴 HIGH** / **11 🟡 MEDIUM** / **6 🟢 LOW** = 24 total
- Project Profile: Bash (73 scripts), Python (3 audit scripts), YAML configs, systemd units
- Overall Health: Core `clashctl.sh` and `common.sh` are solid; highest-risk bugs cluster in **merge_subscription.sh** (YAML corruption), **network_health_monitor.sh** (permanent false-FAILs), and **repair_subscription_and_restore.sh** (crash-then-corrupt sequence)

---

## ① Potential Bugs

| ID | Severity | Location | Category | Description | Remediation |
|----|----------|----------|----------|-------------|-------------|
| BUG-01 | 🟡 MED | [script/clashctl.sh#L117](script/clashctl.sh#L117) | Error handling | Python f-string `d.get("port",0)` uses nested double-quotes — `SyntaxError` on Python < 3.12 (PEP 701). Current system is 3.12.3 so not triggered, but breaks portability to Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Python 3.10). | Change inner quotes to single: `d.get('port', 0)` |
| BUG-02 | 🟡 MED | [install.sh#L19-L20, L50](install.sh#L19) | Error handling | Three `tar -xf` extractions have no error checks. If a zip variable is empty, `tar -xf ""` fails silently and installation continues with missing binaries. | Add `|| _error_quit 'tar extraction failed'` after each `tar` |
| BUG-03 | 🟡 MED | [install.sh#L22](install.sh#L22) | Variable handling | Unquoted glob `${CLASH_BASE_DIR}/bin/yq_*` — `mv` fails silently on zero or multiple matches. | Quote or use a loop: `for f in "${CLASH_BASE_DIR}"/bin/yq_*; do ...` |
| BUG-04 | 🟡 MED | [script/runtime_guard.sh#L174-L175](script/runtime_guard.sh#L174) | Race condition | `_upgrade_to_exclusive()` releases shared lock then re-acquires exclusive — TOCTOU window allows concurrent writer to mutate `runtime.yaml` between unlock and re-lock. | Use `flock --exclusive --timeout 10` upgrade without unlocking first, or re-read the file after re-locking. |
| BUG-05 | 🟡 MED | [install.sh#L154](install.sh#L154) | Logic | `loginctl enable-linger "$USER"` targets `root` when run via `sudo`, not the calling user. | Use `"${SUDO_USER:-$USER}"` |
| BUG-06 | 🟡 MED | [script/clashctl.sh#L577-L648](script/clashctl.sh#L577) | Resource mgmt | `$tmp_out` (`runtime.yaml.merge.$$`) never cleaned up on `_error_quit` paths — each failed update leaks a temp file. | Add `trap 'rm -f "$tmp_out"' RETURN` at function entry |
| BUG-07 | 🟡 MED | [script/clashctl.sh#L212-L213](script/clashctl.sh#L212) | Security | Proxy credentials (`user:pass@`) written to state file without `umask 077` — file is world-readable with default umask 022. | Add `umask 077` before writing or `chmod 600` after |
| BUG-08 | 🟢 LOW | [script/clashctl.sh#L516-L559](script/clashctl.sh#L516) | Resource mgmt | `merge_err` mktemp file leaks when `_error_quit` triggers before the cleanup line at L559. | Same trap pattern as BUG-06 |
| BUG-09 | 🟢 LOW | [script/clashctl.sh#L641-L643](script/clashctl.sh#L641) | Logic | In `CLASH_LIB_MODE=1`, `_error_quit` only returns (doesn't exit) — invalid merged config proceeds to `mv` and overwrites live runtime. | Change to `_valid_config "$tmp_out" || { rm -f "$tmp_out"; _error_quit '...'; return 1; }` |
| BUG-10 | 🟢 LOW | [script/common.sh#L597](script/common.sh#L597) | Variable handling | `$BIN_SUBCONVERTER_PORT` unquoted in function call — empty value causes spurious port reassignment. | Quote: `"$BIN_SUBCONVERTER_PORT"` |
| BUG-11 | 🟡 MED | [vpn-tools/optimize_vscode_copilot.sh#L159-L160](vpn-tools/optimize_vscode_copilot.sh#L159) | Error handling | Under `set -e`, `curl` failure in command substitution exits script before `|| xxx=000` fallback executes — fallback is dead code. | Use `direct_copilot=$(curl ... ) || direct_copilot=000` |
| BUG-12 | 🟡 MED | [vpn-tools/merge_subscription.sh#L114](vpn-tools/merge_subscription.sh#L114) | Logic | `declare -A CUR` inside loop doesn't reinitialize — stale proxy names leak across iterations, suppressing legitimate node additions. | Use `declare -A CUR=()` or add `CUR=()` after declare |
| BUG-13 | 🔴 HIGH | [vpn-tools/merge_subscription.sh#L124](vpn-tools/merge_subscription.sh#L124) | Logic | `${line%%[*]*}` uses shell glob `[*]` (matches literal `*`), not `[`. The old proxy-list tail is never stripped — rebuilt line has two `[...]` sections, producing **invalid YAML output**. | Fix: `${line%%\[*}` |
| BUG-14 | 🔴 HIGH | [vpn-tools/network_health_monitor.sh#L144-L146, L194](vpn-tools/network_health_monitor.sh#L144) | Logic | `IFS='\|' read` splits regex alternations in patterns like `^(20[0-9]\|401\|403\|405)$` — produces truncated ERE `^(20[0-9]` with unbalanced `(`, causing **4 services to permanently report FAIL** regardless of actual HTTP codes. | Use a non-`\|` delimiter (e.g. `$'\x01'` or `\t`) for service record fields |
| BUG-15 | 🟢 LOW | [vpn-tools/trace_mihomo_connections.sh#L40, L119](vpn-tools/trace_mihomo_connections.sh#L40) | Error handling | `--interval` value not validated — non-numeric causes `sleep` failure under `set -e`, silently killing the trace loop. | Add `case "$INTERVAL" in ...` validation like `--seconds` has |
| BUG-16 | 🔴 HIGH | [script/repair_subscription_and_restore.sh#L33](script/repair_subscription_and_restore.sh#L33) | Error handling | `import yaml` (pyyaml) not guaranteed installed — `ImportError` crashes Python, then `set -e` kills the repair script after backup-restore `mv` has already executed, leaving an **inconsistent state**. | Add `try/except ImportError` with graceful fallback |
| BUG-17 | 🔴 HIGH | [script/repair_subscription_and_restore.sh#L44-L48](script/repair_subscription_and_restore.sh#L44) | Error handling | URI parsing `split('@',1)` and `split(':',1)` without `try/except` — malformed trojan URI (missing `@` or `:`) raises `ValueError`, aborting repair mid-flight after config has been moved. | Wrap in `try/except ValueError: continue` |
| BUG-18 | 🔴 HIGH | [script/repair_subscription_and_restore.sh#L58](script/repair_subscription_and_restore.sh#L58) | Security | `'skip-cert-verify': True` hardcoded for all generated proxies — disables TLS verification with no opt-out, enabling MITM attacks. | Default to `False`; make configurable |
| BUG-19 | 🔴 HIGH | [systemd/clash-subscription-refresh.service#L3-L4](systemd/clash-subscription-refresh.service#L3) | Logic | `After=network-online.target` / `Wants=network-online.target` silently ignored in user (`--user`) systemd context — service can start before network is ready. | Use `After=default.target` or add network-wait retry logic in the script |
| BUG-20 | 🟡 MED | [systemd/clash-subscription-refresh.service](systemd/clash-subscription-refresh.service) | Error handling | No `Restart=on-failure` on network-dependent oneshot — transient DNS/TLS failure at 04:30 causes permanent daily miss with no retry. | Add `Restart=on-failure` + `RestartSec=300` |
| BUG-21 | 🟡 MED | [script/emergency_off.sh](script/emergency_off.sh) (rollback) | Variable handling | `${_RB_GNOME_MODE}` unquoted — `gsettings get` returns `'auto'` with embedded single-quotes; `gsettings set` rejects quoted value, making non-manual rollback **silently fail**. | Strip quotes: `"${_RB_GNOME_MODE//\'/}"` |
| BUG-22 | 🟡 MED | [script/audit_curl_blocks.py#L228](script/audit_curl_blocks.py#L228) | Logic | `file_sets_pipefail()` scans raw file lines including heredoc content — a heredoc containing "set -o pipefail" as text (not code) causes false-positive findings. | Use `blocks_from_lines(lines)` instead of raw `lines` |
| BUG-23 | 🟡 MED | [vpn-tools/network_dashboard.sh#L298](vpn-tools/network_dashboard.sh#L298) | Logic | Bar chart rendered **upside-down**: `seq 9 -1 0` makes threshold run 10→100 top-to-bottom (low thresholds most filled at top). | Change to `seq 0 9` so 100→10 runs top-to-bottom |
| BUG-24 | 🟢 LOW | [script/audit_json_stdout_purity.py#L195](script/audit_json_stdout_purity.py#L195) | Logic/Regex | `RE_MODE_ASSIGN` misses double-quoted form `MODE="${1:-text}"` — false negative in JSON-mode detection. | Allow optional double-quotes in regex pattern |

## Remediation Roadmap

### Priority 1 — 🔴 Critical (fix before next release)

| ID | Fix effort | Impact |
|----|-----------|--------|
| BUG-13 | 1-line glob fix in merge_subscription.sh | **Prevents YAML corruption** every time proxy-group append runs |
| BUG-14 | Change field delimiter in network_health_monitor.sh | **Fixes 4 services permanently false-FAIL**; affects health dashboard accuracy |
| BUG-16 | Add `try/except ImportError` in repair script | **Prevents repair-mid-crash** leaving system in broken state |
| BUG-17 | Add `try/except ValueError` around URI parsing | **Prevents repair-mid-crash** on malformed subscription URIs |
| BUG-18 | Change `skip-cert-verify` default to `False` | **Eliminates MITM attack surface** on all repaired proxy configs |
| BUG-19 | Replace user-unit `After=network-online.target` | **Fixes subscription refresh race at boot** |

### Priority 2 — 🟡 Warning (fix in next maintenance cycle)

| ID | Fix effort | Impact |
|----|-----------|--------|
| BUG-01 | Change inner quotes in f-string | Portability to Python 3.10/3.11 |
| BUG-02 | Add error guards after `tar` | Prevent silent broken installs |
| BUG-04 | Atomic lock upgrade | Prevent rare concurrent-update corruption |
| BUG-05 | Use `SUDO_USER` for linger | Fix user service auto-start under sudo installs |
| BUG-06, BUG-08 | Add trap cleanup | Eliminate temp file leaks in clashctl |
| BUG-07 | Add `umask 077` | Protect proxy credentials in state file |
| BUG-11 | Fix `set -e` + command substitution | Make Copilot optimizer resilient to curl failures |
| BUG-12 | Reinitialize assoc array in loop | Fix node deduplication in merge script |
| BUG-20 | Add `Restart=on-failure` to systemd unit | Fix permanent daily miss on transient errors |
| BUG-21 | Strip quotes from gsettings value | Fix emergency-off rollback for GNOME proxy |
| BUG-22 | Use block-parsed lines for pipefail detection | Eliminate false positives in audit tool |
| BUG-23 | Fix bar chart direction | Correct visual display in network dashboard |

### Priority 3 — 🟢 Enhancement (backlog)

| ID | Fix effort | Impact |
|----|-----------|--------|
| BUG-03 | Quote glob or use loop | Defensive install robustness |
| BUG-09 | Guard LIB_MODE return path | Prevent bad-config install in library mode |
| BUG-10 | Quote variable | Defensive port check |
| BUG-15 | Add interval validation | Better UX for trace tool |
| BUG-24 | Expand regex for mode detection | Reduce false negatives in audit |
